degree_requirement.value: first professionally qualifying degree in the field of “Informatik” or Computer Science or in a related study program
degree_requirement.quote: The specific admission requirement is a first professionally qualifying degree in the field of “Informatik” or Computer Science or in a related study program.

value.area: foundations of computer sciences (including theoretical, computer engineering/IT, and methodological-practical)

subject_credits.quote:
Study programs in the above subject area and related study programs must contain at least the following components:

- 36 CP in foundations of computer sciences, including 12 CP in the field of Theoretical Computer Science , 12 CP in the field of Computer Engineering or Information Technology, 12 CP in the field of Methodological and Practical Computer Science

- 18 CP in the field of Mathematics,

- and additionally, at least 30 CP in the field of computer sciences, not including your thesis

english.quote: For the IELTS test, an overall band score of 6.5 is required, even if an overall band score of 5.5 confirms a B2 on the certificate.

work_experience.quote: You are not formally required to do an internship either before or during the program, but we recommend you do so.

application_route.quote: Master’s applicants who earned or will earn their first university degree (generally a bachelor’s) at a German university and are applying with a ECTS certificate (European Credit Transfer System (ECTS), see infobox) must submit their application directly to the TU Berlin.

selection_process.quote: The Master's program is admission-free (open admission).

required_documents.quote: If your application has not been reviewed by the examination board in terms of content, it is highly likely that your application did not include one or more of the following documents: •    A recognized English language certificate (this is mandatory for all Master's programs) or •    A Suitability Assessment Form (this is mandatory for the Master's programs in Automotive Systems, Computer Science (Informatik) and Medientechnik).

language_of_instruction.quote: The master’s program is taught in English.
